exposure: birth at a metropolitan private hospital
cohort: 634 women who experienced antepartum stillbirth in Western Australia between 2010 and 2015
finding: The study found that caesarean section rates among women with antepartum stillbirths in Western Australia were low and increased with gestational age.
mod_finding: The overall caesarean section rate among women with antepartum stillbirths was low.
birth_weight: Large-for-gestational-age birthweight was associated with increased cesarean section risk.
